name: customer_orders_analyze_amazon_sales_performance
description:
Analyzes placed-order sales performance over time from sp_api_iceberg.orders_v2026.

Use this tool to:
- Track daily, weekly, or monthly revenue and order volume trends
- Monitor fulfillment status mix (shipped / pending / canceled) over time
- Analyze FBA (AMAZON) vs FBM split by period
- Compare gross revenue and average order value across time windows
- Filter by marketplace, order status, fulfillment channel, or seller

Key metrics per period:
- orders: distinct placed orders (deduplicated to latest snapshot)
- gross_revenue: sum of order grand_total amounts
- avg_order_value: gross_revenue ÷ orders
- shipped_count / pending_count / canceled_count: status breakdown
- fba_count / fbm_count: fulfillment channel split

Granularity: day (default), week, or month.
Default window: last 3 months. Use start_date/end_date for exact ranges.

Time zone: periods are bucketed in the requested time_zone (default America/Los_Angeles / LA), matching NeonPanel reporting. Order timestamps (UTC) are converted to this zone before date filtering and bucketing, so a 'day' is a local-calendar day, not a UTC day.

Currency: each row carries native amounts (gross_revenue / avg_order_value in the marketplace's own currency) AND main-currency amounts (gross_revenue_main / avg_order_value_main), converted to the company's main_currency (app_companies.currency) at each order's date via currency_rates. Use native for per-marketplace figures and main-currency for cross-marketplace aggregation — both are always returned.

marketplace_ids.description: Amazon marketplace IDs (e.g. 'ATVPDKIKX0DER'). Omit for all.

order_statuses.description: Filter to specific fulfillment statuses. Omit for all.

fulfillment_channels.description: fulfilled_by values: 'AMAZON' (FBA) or merchant ID (FBM). Omit for all.

seller_ids.description: Filter to specific seller IDs. Omit for all sellers.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone (e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles') or fixed offset (e.g. '-08:00') used for date filtering and day/week/month bucketing. Defaults to America/Los_Angeles (LA). Order timestamps (UTC) are converted to this zone first.

currency.description: Native currency of this marketplace row.

gross_revenue_main.description: Revenue converted to main_currency at each order's date.

avg_order_value.description: Avg order value in native currency.
